newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico IMSA acquires Guatemala steelmaker.
newsitem.headline: Mexico IMSA acquires Guatemala steelmaker.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo IMSA SA de CV said on Thursday it had acquired 100 percent of Guatemalan steel producer Industria Galvanizadora SA (INGASA) for $12.1 million.
IMSA made the acquisition through its subsidiary IMSA ACERO, which focuses on steel processing and the production of coated and non-coated steel, the company said in a statement.
"This acquisition will provide a broader and more complete supply of products to the rapidly developing Central American markets," IMSA said.
It said INGASA was Central America's largest galvanized steel producer, with a capacity of 80,000 tons per year in continuous galvanizing lines. It expects 1997 sales of $27 million.
Grupo IMSA is a diversified Mexican industrial company which conducts business in steel processing products, automotive batteries and construction products.
